title: Uniqueness of the normalized external cup homology family
statement: For a field k, schemes X,Y over k and any modules F,G, write the scalar models and their tensor total as in [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. Define IsPicardExternalCupHomology for a natural-degree family φ of maps from total homology to product scalar-model homology by exactly the tensor-cycle formula of IsPicardExternalCupCochain, with φ n in place of H(c). If φ and ψ both satisfy this predicate, then φ n=ψ n for every natural n. No quasi-coherence or geometric compactness assumption is needed.

source.place: Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech (33.29.1.1); Cohomology Tags 01FD, 07MB, 0FKV; official tag pages read

proof.text: Apply natural-degree tensor Kunneth to the constructed scalar models, which vanish in negative degrees. Precompose φ n and ψ n with its linear equivalence. DirectSum.linearMap_ext and TensorProduct.ext reduce equality to pure tensors of factor homology classes.

Lift both factor classes by the surjective homology projections. The Kunneth cycle formula supplies a total cycle representing their tensor. Both normalizations give the same external cup value. Cancel the injective scalar-model comparison, then use surjectivity of the Kunneth equivalence to conclude equality.

theorem picardExternalCupHomology_unique
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    (φ ψ : ∀ n : ℕ, (picardExternalTotal f g F G).homology (n : ℤ) ⟶
      (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (n : ℤ))
    (hφ : IsPicardExternalCupHomology f g F G φ)
    (hψ : IsPicardExternalCupHomology f g F G ψ) (n : ℕ) : φ n = ψ n
